description: 05-astrocytoma-idh-mutant-cdkn2a - regenerated 2026-09-19 for the shared CNS diagnosis core: the glioma path now takes the four layers from schemas/_cns_layers.json (Layer 2 histopathological classification and the branched Layer 4 panel replace the flat glioma feature, immunohistochemistry and molecular lists), so the same tumour reads identically on the biopsy and on the resection.
report:
Brain, right frontal lesion, stereotactic biopsy

Two smear preparations are made from the tissue. They show a fibrillary glial background traversed by elongated hyperchromatic nuclei with fine cytoplasmic processes. Sections show three pieces of tissue comprising a diffusely infiltrating astrocytic neoplasm in which atypical glial cells with elongated hyperchromatic nuclei permeate the cortex and white matter. The tumour shows increased cellularity, nuclear atypia and mitotic activity. Mitoses number 4 per 10 high-power fields. On immunohistochemistry, the tumour cells are positive for GFAP. The Ki-67 proliferation index is approximately 12 per cent. On molecular testing, IDH1 R132H is expressed, there is loss of nuclear ATRX expression, p53 shows an abnormal pattern (mutated pattern), 1p and 19q are retained and there is homozygous deletion of CDKN2A/B.

BRAIN, right frontal lobe, stereotactic biopsy - ASTROCYTOMA, IDH-mutant, CNS WHO grade 4
- Histological appearance: diffuse astrocytic glioma, showing increased cellularity, nuclear atypia and mitotic activity
- Histopathological classification: diffuse astrocytoma
- Immunohistochemistry: GFAP positive
- Molecular parameters: IDH1 R132H (immunohistochemistry) positive; ATRX (immunohistochemistry) loss of nuclear expression; p53 (immunohistochemistry) abnormal (mutated pattern); 1p/19q (FISH) no deletion detected; CDKN2A / CDKN2B homozygous deletion detected
- CNS WHO grade 4

MGMT promoter methylation testing has been requested; the result will be issued in a supplementary report.
